title: B02 + programmable logical fault injection (research overlay)

attention_probabilities.note: softmax probabilities are non-negative; signed 10-bit code

reference.note: injection off: bit-identical to the canonical core; injection rows: 64-bit-long C-model (hls/research/b03_inject/make_lp64_cmodel.py)

outputs.pred_class: AXI-Lite register: FPGA argmax, lowest index on ties; class map 0 normal, 1 imbalance, 2 misalignment, 3 bearing_fault
outputs.integrity_status: integrity_status (AXI-Lite, metadata, never a class): bit0 input-buffer XOR signature (after ingress vs after projection), bit1 classifier tail evaluated twice and compared (time-multiplexed on ONE compute unit: detects transient upsets of one evaluation, not persistent/common-mode faults), bit2 projection accumulator outside its proven bound |acc+b| <= 719,316
outputs.injection: inj_site/inj_word/inj_bit (AXI-Lite, research only): 0 off, 1 input word bit (10-bit code), 2 projection accumulator bit (32-bit), 3 logit of the first tail evaluation; written while the core is idle, applied to the next ap_start only (transient, one window)

source.build: powershell -File tools/build_raw_core.ps1 -Variant b03; vivado -mode batch -source tools/vivado/rerun_impl_strategy.tcl -tclargs tmp/vb03/vb03.xpr Performance_ExplorePostRoutePhysOpt

timing: default implementation WNS -0.437 ns (failed, kept in b03_build/first_impl_timing_fail); Performance_ExplorePostRoutePhysOpt: WNS 0.000 ns (met, no reported margin)

input.representation: raw 24-bit ADC codes, one per little-endian int32 word; 8192 words per window, row-major [sample, channel] (word = sample*8 + channel), TLAST on word 8191
input.on_fpga_preprocessing: per-window per-channel integer z-score -> INT10 codes (+-511) -> 4:1 non-overlapping mean aggregation (1024 -> 256 tokens) inside transformer_top

golden.format: golden_in.txt: header 'count 1024 8', then one window of raw24 codes per line

physical_validation.result: 1,408/1,408 rows = 64-bit-long C-model; 88/93 class-changing faults flagged, 5 silent

physical_validation.what: board full test, injection off (95,404 clean test windows)
physical_validation.result: 95,404/95,404 logits and class = canonical C-model, integrity_status 0 on all

status: physically validated on the MYIR Z-Turn XC7Z020
board: MYIR Z-Turn MYS-7Z020-C-S, XC7Z020-1CLG400C, 100 MHz, PYNQ 2.4 / Python 3.6
